title: Virtual reality based cognitive behavioral therapy for paranoia: Effects on mental states and the dynamics among them
limitations: - Items were rated on 7-point Likert scales, limiting variation; - Conservative permutation tests limited statistical power; - No correction for multiple testing; - Baseline difference in one association unexplained; - Data missing at random assumption may be violated; - Limited sample size may reduce power to detect changes in dynamics.
notes: The study used a network approach to examine dynamics among mental states, but did not formally test centrality differences between groups. The authors did not report specific preregistration links, but the trial was registered (ISRCTN 12929657).
